background.zh: 由海倫·林梅爾（Helen H. Lemmel）於1922年作詞作曲。她讀到宣教士莉莉亞斯·特羅特（Lilias Trotter）小冊子中的一段話——「當轉眼仰望耶穌，定睛在祂奇妙慈容」——深受感動，遂寫成此詩並譜上曲調。英文原詞已進入公有領域；此處中文為華人教會通用的傳統譯詞。
background.en: Words and music by Helen H. Lemmel, written in 1922. She was moved by a passage in a booklet by missionary Lilias Trotter — "Turn your eyes upon Jesus, look full in His wonderful face" — and set it to music. The English text is now in the public domain; the Chinese lines here follow the traditional rendering used in Chinese churches.

en: O soul, are you weary and troubled?
No light in the darkness you see?
There’s light for a look at the Savior,
And life more abundant and free!

zh: 在救主榮耀恩典大光中，
en: Turn your eyes upon Jesus,
Look full in His wonderful face,
And the things of earth will grow strangely dim,
In the light of His glory and grace.
Thro' death into life everlasting,
He passed, and we follow Him there;
O’er us sin no more hath dominion--
For more than conqu’rors we are!

zh: 在救主榮耀恩典大光中，
en: Turn your eyes upon Jesus,
Look full in His wonderful face,
And the things of earth will grow strangely dim,
In the light of His glory and grace.
His Word shall not fail you--He promised;
Believe Him, and all will be well:
Then go to a world that is dying,
His perfect salvation to tell!

zh: 在救主榮耀恩典大光中，
en: Turn your eyes upon Jesus,
Look full in His wonderful face,
And the things of earth will grow strangely dim,
In the light of His glory and grace.
